turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, then tell me who decided it and whether Owen was heard first.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why is there a zero in the gradebook? Answer the question, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To: Hale
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed.
I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that you tell me who decided the zero and whether Owen was heard before it was entered.
I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing.
